notes.title: v1.6.0 changeLog
notes.notes:
1. Added key config function, which can customize keys in the setting interface.
2. Increase the effect of killing the screen (can be turned off in the settings interface).
3. Added the special effect of killing and being hit.
4. The death resurrection mechanism in Chapter 6 has been modified so that it can be resurrected from the current map.
5. Modified the boss mechanism of some boss levels.
6. Slightly increased the movement speed of the protagonist.
7. The attack method of the enemy wolf has been modified, and the attack judgment will no longer be generated during the wolf's forward pounce.
8. Bomb-throwing enemies and self-explosive soldiers will cause damage to the enemy.
9. The horse riding operation is optimized, and the movement performance of the brown horse is improved.
10. Fixed many bugs and increased the stability of the program.
